verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents official SDKs across web, mobile, and backend with a unified identity/event/consent model, an auto-detecting Wizard CLI installer, and HTTP/Experiment APIs for programmatic use (amplitude-docs-1, -3, -4, -16, -27, -35). However, a hands-on community report states integration was 'actually very hard' with data often wrong, undercutting the smooth-SDK narrative. missing for 10: independent third-party verification of SDK quality/ease, resolution of the hands-on integration-difficulty complaint, and broader coverage beyond marketing docs.
